observations: Seller text claims testing, but no new photos/videos were provided.
Photos still show only a solar panel (no battery shown).
Panel wattage/brand/model label is still not readable in the provided images.

claims.claim: Battery is new, holds charge for 8 hours.
claims.evidence: No battery is shown in the provided photos; no battery label/serial or test result is visible.
No battery repair history indicators or documentation are visible; no battery photos/serial shown.

claims.claim: I tested it myself yesterday, everything I said is true.
claims.evidence: No test proof (video/screenshot/meter readings) was provided, and no new photos were sent.

risks.risk: Mismatch risk: seller claims battery performance, but only a solar panel is shown in photos.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the exact battery being sold (front label/brand, terminals, and close-up of rating plate/serial).
risks.if_unproven: Price as solar panel only; battery not included / battery performance not guaranteed.

risks.risk: Panel wattage/ratings not readable, which determines market price.
risks.proof: Ask for a close-up photo of the panel’s rating label showing Wp (watts), Voc, Isc, and brand/model.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case/lowest plausible wattage category for used panels.

risks.risk: No performance test evidence for either panel or battery (no meter readings).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video showing measured Voc and Isc (panel) and/or battery voltage under load, plus the meter readings on screen.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not performance-tested (assume reduced output/unknown capacity).

risks.risk: Condition risk (micro-cracks/delamination) cannot be confirmed from glare and lack of close-ups.
risks.proof: Ask for close-up, glare-free photos of frame corners and cell grid, and a back-side photo showing any burn/corrosion.

proof_requests: Send battery photos (label/rating plate + serial + terminals) to confirm the battery is included.
Send a close-up of the solar panel rating label (Wp/Voc/Isc/brand/model).
Send meter readings proof: panel Voc & Isc (or IV curve) and battery voltage under load (video with meter visible).
response.reason: The seller’s reply is not supported by any new evidence. The photos still don’t show the battery, and the panel’s key pricing specs (wattage/label) remain unreadable, so a reliable worst-case price can’t be set.
